title: Final goal integration docs and verification
objective: Verify the complete /goal feature, document user behavior, and report residual risks.
context: This task should run after implementation surfaces are complete.
It owns final evidence, not broad refactoring.

source_evidence.note: Document transcript-only evaluator and permission boundary.
Document set/view/edit/pause/resume/clear controls and 4000-char objective limit.

include: Add docs/goal.md with user-facing command and tool behavior.
Document evaluator limitations and permission boundaries.
Run focused Goal tests across changed packages.
Record remaining risks and any disabled paths.
exclude: No new feature work unless a failing test reveals a tiny wiring miss.

implementation_steps: Summarize evidence, failures, and residual risks.
deliverables: Verification evidence for the complete feature.
acceptance_criteria: Docs describe /goal set, status, edit, pause, resume, clear, evaluator behavior, and permissions.
Related package tests pass or failures are clearly unrelated and documented.
risks: Full go test ./... may be slower than the 5-minute task budget; run focused tests first and broaden only as time allows.
dispatch_prompt: Write docs/goal.md and run final focused verification for the /goal feature. Summarize changed files, test evidence, and residual risks without broad refactoring.
notes_for_assignee: If a critical wiring miss appears, fix only the smallest local issue and record it.
